title: Service Client Module Compiler
description: Compiles a typed HTTP service client for a single upstream provider. Enforces: base URL from config (not hardcoded), auth injection via interceptor (not per-call), all responses mapped to typed domain objects, circuit-breaker or retry declared, no request body logging of sensitive fields.

error_codes.SC002: client-runtime-artifact.json not found — compile service-client-runtime first
error_codes.SC003: Hardcoded base URL found — must come from config/env via client runtime
error_codes.SC004: Auth token injected per-call instead of via interceptor/middleware
error_codes.SC005: Response not mapped to typed domain object (raw any/unknown returned)
error_codes.SC006: Non-2xx response not mapped to typed error class
error_codes.SC007: No retry or circuit-breaker declared for this client
error_codes.SC008: Sensitive request field (password, token, secret) logged without redaction
